title: Performance Optimization
description: Make React apps faster with memoization, lazy loading, and React 19 features.
longDescription: As React apps grow, performance matters. This module teaches React.memo, useMemo, useCallback, and the new React 19 compiler optimizations. You'll learn when optimizing actually helps and when it adds complexity without benefit.
whatYouLearn: Wrap components with React.memo to skip unnecessary re-renders
Understand React 19 Actions, the use() hook, and Server Components basics
